description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {C}{C}
Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token creature with haste.
Activate the Graveborn token using the ability granted by Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Graveborn token, adding {C}{C}
Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Nether Traitor using the ability granted by Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
